name: Angolatitan
sum: Angolatitan is a titanosauriform sauropod from the Upper Cretaceous of Angola, the first non-avian dinosaur found there.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: A partial right forelimb found by Octavio Mateus near Iembe, Bengo, in May 2005.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Mateus et al. 2011
